name: Toast
purpose: Displays a non-blocking notification. Use Toast for one controlled message; ToastProvider + useToast for a queued portal toaster.
scenarios: Confirm that a document was saved
Warn that an action failed without blocking the UI
Notify that a background process completed

closeLabel.description: Accessible label for the close action.

duration.description: Auto-close delay in milliseconds. 0 keeps the toast until the parent closes it.

onOpenChange.description: Notifies the parent when the toast should close.

variants.name: status
variants.description: Semantic tone that changes the accent color.

antiPatterns: Do not use toasts for critical errors that require user action; use a dialog or alert.
Do not auto-dismiss without a way to reopen the message.

a11y.focus: Focus is not stolen on open; the toast is announced via aria-live.
a11y.labeling: Title labels the status region; description is associated.

responsive.strategy: Toasts are anchored to the bottom-end of the viewport and shrink to fit on compact screens.

breakpoints.compact: Toast uses most of the viewport width with safe-area offsets.
breakpoints.medium: Toast uses a fixed max width anchored to the corner.
breakpoints.large: Toast uses a fixed max width anchored to the corner.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. The accent border is on the inline-start side.

mechanics: Toast is a presentational status region. duration 0 (default) stays until onOpenChange(false). ToastProvider mounts an Ark Toaster portal with a queue; useToast().push enqueues items that auto-dismiss. Do not use toasts for errors that require a decision.
usage: For one message, render Toast with open, title, description, closeLabel, and onOpenChange.
For app-wide notifications, wrap the tree in ToastProvider and call useToast().push({ title, description, status }).
Pass duration greater than 0 to auto-dismiss. Keep a close control so the message is not lost.

exports.name: Toast
exports.description: Controlled single toast. Stays in document flow.

exports.name: ToastProvider
exports.description: Creates a toaster store, portals the queue, and provides useToast.

exports.name: useToast
exports.signature: function useToast(): { push: Function; dismiss: Function }
exports.description: Enqueue or dismiss toasts. Requires ToastProvider.
